_note: shots.json starter (SHOTS.md). Ask Alex which model first (h3 or seedance) and set "model"; nothing is assumed. Each shot keeps Alex's own words in brief/script verbatim; list every field Claude adds in "proposed" until Alex OKs it (`shots.py confirm ID`). Replace every <FILL: …> hint (check refuses any left). Paths are relative to the job folder; people/places name entries in the casting spec.

glasses.anatomy: A single wraparound shield lens under a slim frame band, a small round camera lens at the upper corner by the bridge.
glasses.colourway: a mirrored gold lens, matte black frame

S01.brief: She stands at the cliff edge at dawn, then we pull back to show the whole valley.

key.frame: A close-up of her face at the cliff edge, eyes on the horizon, wind in her hair.
key.light: Cool dawn light from the left, soft and low.

beats: She breathes in and looks down into the valley.
She smiles and steps back from the edge.

S02.brief: Upside down on the cliff she asks her glasses if they are filming, they answer, and she flips off the edge.
S02.scene: On a windy overcast ridge she holds a one-arm handstand, talks to her glasses, then pushes off backward over the edge.
S02.first: A close-up of her upside-down face, the gold lens in the centre of the frame, the rock at the bottom, mist behind.
S02.final: Her full body in the centre, palm on the crest, legs in a wide V against the sky; the ridge crosses the lower third.
S02.light: Overcast daylight, soft and diffuse, that brightens and dims as the clouds move.

only: the pink lines of her suit

audio: the calm voice from the glasses
her joyful scream fading below the ridge
locks: She falls backward, away from the camera, and the ridge stays empty to the last frame.

beats.do: The pull-back begins on her face; she balances with tiny corrections.
A calm voice answers from the glasses; she grins.
She pushes off backward over the far side of the ridge and drops out of sight, screaming with joy.
The camera holds on the empty ridge, mist streaming across.
